title: Real Blender 5.2 compiler-controlled temporal owner-token pass probe
question: Can Material Index or a scalar custom AOV transport a deterministic compiler-assigned per-owner token through Blender 5.2 Cycles multilayer EXR when distinct analytic owners deliberately share Object Index?
decisionRole: pass-semantics and transport feasibility only; no temporal reconstruction candidate is promoted

requirements: All five tool paths and both output roots are absent at preregistration.
Preflight performs zero render calls and freezes exact tool hashes plus the tool-freeze commit.
Formal creates its root once and never overwrites a source, result, audit or receipt.
Every source render launches from factory startup in a fresh Blender process with isolated config, scripts and temporary directories.

analyticMaskContract.source: independent orthographic pixel-center projection from the frozen camera, resolution, owner bounds and frame location
analyticMaskContract.foregroundInterior: pixel center lies at least three pixels inside all four projected foreground edges
analyticMaskContract.backgroundInterior: pixel center lies inside the projected background and at least three pixels outside the projected foreground bounds
analyticMaskContract.boundaryBand: pixel center lies within three pixels of any projected foreground edge while inside the projected background

measurementContract.passDiscovery: OpenImageIO multipart roster and channel names are recorded; each expected suffix must resolve to exactly one finite float32 subimage.
measurementContract.interiorDiscreteness: For every owner, frame, display cell and repeat, every stable-interior sample equals the frozen mechanism token exactly as float32.
measurementContract.identitySeparation: Material Index and custom AOV stable-interior tokens differ between owners while Object Index equals 7 for both.
measurementContract.displayInvariance: For a fixed frame and repeat, every Object Index, Material Index and custom AOV float32 array is byte-identical between ACES_SDR and UN_TONE_MAPPED.
measurementContract.repeatDeterminism: For a fixed frame and display cell, every tested pass float32 array is byte-identical between the two clean-process repeats.
measurementContract.boundaryCharacterization: For each mechanism, report finite unique values, minimum, maximum, exact-token count, non-token count and SHA over the frozen boundary band; boundary fractions are measured but do not change the interior denominator.
measurementContract.sourceIntegrity: Every source report self-hash, EXR SHA, runtime identity, scene cardinality, pass settings, render-call count and compiler token assignment is verified.

requiredTargets: make owners share custom AOV value
swap foreground and background Material Index
swap foreground and background custom AOV value
perturb one stable-interior Material Index sample
perturb one stable-interior custom AOV sample
shrink an interior below the frozen minimum
claim Object Index distinguishes the owners

frozenDecision.mapping: Evaluate common and mechanism-specific gates independently; Object Index must behave as the preregistered negative control. Select the exact label corresponding to the two viability booleans.
frozenDecision.promotionRule: A viable label permits a separately preregistered H1 integration intervention; it does not itself validate temporal reconstruction.

nonClaims: This probe does not revise the D12.9-H1 bounded verdict or coverage denominator.
Stable-interior token transport does not prove boundary samples are safe for temporal reuse.
Material Index viability does not prove multi-material analytic owners are automatically handled.
Custom AOV viability does not prove every third-party material can be injected without semantic change.
Byte determinism on this CPU fixture does not prove cross-device or cross-Blender-version determinism.
No perceptual quality, speedup, production cost or final-film claim is made.
No model or video-generation system participates.
